Höglandsleden etapp HÖ3 Valbacken - Mariannelund - En del av Smålandsleden

officialSources.officialDescriptionSummary: HÖ3 starts at Valbacken above Ingatorp, 278 m above sea level, near Valbacken's ski area and summer cafe. The official text describes views over the area, then a route along or near Silverån, one of Emån's larger tributaries. The Silverån valley between Byasjön and Åsjön is presented as a clear-water wilderness corridor and a nature-interest area. The section ends at Filmbyn in Mariannelund, where the trail connects onward toward Emilleden, Severedsleden and the Kalmar county side.
officialSources.appDetailTextDraft: This Höglandsleden branch stage runs east from Valbacken above Ingatorp to Filmbyn in Mariannelund. After the Valbacken viewpoint and ski-area trailhead, the route crosses forest, small roads and the Silverån landscape before reaching the Åsjön shelter near the eastern end. The last approach ends directly at the Mariannelund/Filmbyn trailhead, with town access and onward connections toward Emilleden and the Kalmar county trails. Treat Valbacken and Mariannelund services as seasonal or opening-hour dependent, and do not rely on potable water mid-stage.

waterSources.name: Valbackens Toppstuga water
waterSources.reliability: medium in open season; unavailable in winter per official page
waterSources.notes: Official Valbacken shelter page says the basement toilet gives access to water, but the toilet is closed in winter. Field/route-app reports also warn that Valbacken cafe/service availability varies.

waterSources.name: Åsjön and Silverån surface water
waterSources.notes: HÖ3 follows or approaches the Silverån/Åsjön landscape, but no official potable-water point was found at Åsjön. Treat lakes and streams as natural water requiring treatment and subject to dry/flood conditions.

waterSources.name: Filmbyn / Spilhammar commercial services
waterSources.notes: Useful endpoint services but not a guaranteed public trail water point. Verify opening hours and public access before user-facing import.

camping.notes: Official overnight-relevant facilities are Valbacken shelter at the start and Åsjön shelter near the end. No official free tent site was found mid-stage. Spilhammars Camping near Mariannelund is a commercial endpoint service. Larger organized camps in Hässleby-Silverån reserve may require permission under reserve rules.

shelter.notes: Valbacken shelter is shared with HÖ2/HÖ4 at the start. Åsjön shelter is the key HÖ3 shelter near Mariannelund and is officially listed for three people with table, grill, beach and nearby dry toilet.

fire.notes: Official fire/grill places are present at Valbacken and Åsjön. In Hässleby-Silverån reserve, Länsstyrelsen rules say fires may only be made with brought wood. Current municipal/Länsstyrelsen fire-ban status must be checked before relying on any fireplace.

toilets.notes: Valbacken has toilet/water in Toppstugan but the official page says the toilet is closed in winter. Åsjön has a dry toilet about 60 m toward Spilhammar. Mariannelund/Filmbyn ledentré lists toilet as an endpoint service, but public availability depends on facility access/opening conditions.

protectedAreas.name: Hässleby-Silverån naturreservat
protectedAreas.notes: HÖ3/Smålandsleden passes through or along the western side of the reserve according to official/agent research. Rules include no damaging natural material or deadwood, fires only with brought wood, cycling and riding only on roads or marked Höglandsleden/Smålandsleden, no collecting protected plants/mosses/lichens/fungi except berries and edible mushrooms, no collecting invertebrates except the listed fishing-right signal-crayfish exception, no unauthorized signs/posters, and permission requirements for events over 100 people or camps over 30 people.

protectedAreas.name: Silverån valley nature-interest corridor
protectedAreas.notes: The official HÖ3 page describes the Silverån valley from Byasjön to Åsjön as valuable clear-water wilderness and a nature-interest area. Do not apply reserve rules outside confirmed protected-area boundaries without GIS intersection.

dogs.notes: No HÖ3-specific dog ban was found. General Swedish guidance applies: dogs must be under extra control from 1 March to 20 August and should be leashed near wildlife, livestock and in sensitive areas.

huntingForestryAndLivestock.notes: No active HÖ3-specific hunting or forestry closure was found on 2026-04-29. Add standard caveats to follow signs, respect temporary closures, use extra dog control and close gates where the route crosses rural land.

currentClosures.notes: No HÖ3-specific closure, reroute or trail-status warning was found on the official HÖ3 page, Naturkartan API or Hässleby-Silverån reserve page. Naturkartan site 128394 was updated 2026-04-27T13:16:41.

hazards.name: Steep and rugged sections near Valbacken and Silverån/Hässleby-Silverån
hazards.notes: Field reports describe a steep start/Valbacken descent/ascent context and a notable climb after Silverån toward Stubbaberg. Hässleby-Silverån reserve is described as steep and rugged.

hazards.name: Silverån high-water/flood risk
hazards.notes: SMHI historical material records major flooding in Silverån/Mariannelund on 2012-07-07 to 2012-07-08. Treat river-adjacent sections and low crossings with caution after heavy rain.

hazards.name: Water reliability
hazards.notes: No potable mid-stage water was confirmed. Do not rely on Åsjön/Silverån surface water without treatment, and do not rely on Valbacken or Filmbyn services outside opening hours.

fishing.notes: Ingatorp/Silverån fishing-area sources list season, bait and catch restrictions; this is recreation context rather than trail access. Recheck iFiske/FVO rules before importing fishing-specific guidance.

conditionReports.summary: Local report walked Valbacken/Ingatorp to Mariannelund as about 19 km in about 4 h 30 min. It describes an initially steep, pulse-raising route through old forest, rocky hills and pine, then a middle portion with 5-6 km of gravel/forest road. Silverån and the reserve were scenic; the climb after the river toward Stubbaberg was described as hard. The Åsjön shelter was reported vandalized/littered/graffiti-marked and without firewood at that time.
conditionReports.importImpact: Good route-character and condition context. Do not suppress official Åsjön facilities based only on this 2020 report; retain as a currentness caveat.

conditionReports.summary: Day 3 Ingatorp-Mariannelund was reported as 22 km. The trail was described as well marked and good, mostly small forest/gravel roads, with Silverån visible only in a few places.
conditionReports.importImpact: Older route-character context only; do not use its distance as canonical.

conditionReports.summary: Route-app page lists the older section name as Delsträcka 4, about 16.4 km and moderate, with a recent positive condition/views signal.
conditionReports.importImpact: Useful recent user-signal context, but official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan HÖ3 metadata and GPX remain canonical.

sourceContradictions.topic: Current HÖ3 vs older route-app/OSM naming
sourceContradictions.details: Current official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan calls the section HÖ3 Valbacken-Mariannelund, 16.7 km. OSM and route apps often use older names such as Delsträcka 4 Ingatorp-Mariannelund or Stage 6, with distances ranging from about 16.2 km to 25.8 km depending on packaging and variants.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: High. Use official HÖ3 metadata and GPX/API geometry as canonical.

sourceContradictions.details: Older OSM relation 10553744 computes to about 17.975 km and has its last point about 642 m from the current official Filmbyn endpoint.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Medium. Do not use OSM relation 10553744 as canonical route geometry.

sourceContradictions.details: The official connector text says 1.8 km, metadata says 1.9 km and computed official connector geometry is about 1.943 km.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Low-medium. Model as separate access/connection metadata and avoid merging it into HÖ3.

sourceContradictions.details: Official pages list Åsjön as an active shelter with grill, beach and dry toilet; a 2020 field report described vandalism/litter/graffiti/no firewood, while later route-app tips again treat it as usable.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Medium. Import official facility with a condition caveat and recheck if high confidence is required.

sourceContradictions.details: Official/local sources list cafe, toilet, water and restaurant services at endpoints, but field/route-app reports and official text indicate seasonal/opening-hour dependency, including Valbacken toilet closed in winter.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Medium. Import as seasonal/service metadata, not as always-reliable water.

sourceContradictions.details: Some Visit Eksjö service pages include malformed or clearly wrong coordinate text. The HÖ3 synthesis uses official Smålandsleden/Naturkartan, OSM and facility-agent coordinates instead.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Low-medium. Do not normalize Visit Eksjö coordinates without independent verification.

sourceContradictions.details: Official text says HÖ3 connects in Mariannelund toward Emilleden and the Kalmar county side via Severedsleden, but those are not part of the HÖ3 GPX line.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Medium. Model as external connection metadata, not as Höglandsleden geometry.

agents.result: Confirmed official HÖ3 metadata, Valbacken/Mariannelund endpoint objects, Åsjön shelter, Mariannelund connector, Emilleden/Severedsleden connection notes and Hässleby-Silverån reserve context.

Confirmed official GPX/API linework as 1 segment, 794 points, 16.668 km, navigation-grade, and clean endpoint continuity; flagged OSM old Delsträcka 4 mismatch and separate Mariannelund connector geometry.
Collected Valbacken shared facilities, Åsjön shelter/fire/toilet/swimming, Filmbyn/Mariannelund endpoint services, Spilhammar nearby services and off-route endpoint service candidates.
Confirmed start access via Ingatorp centrum/Stationsgatan, end access via Göreda bro, Mariannelund station and Mariannelund torget, and endpoint parking at Valbacken and Filmbyn.
Found Hemomkringvandring, Utsidan, AllTrails, Komoot and route-app reports; added route-character, Åsjön condition, service seasonality and old-name/distance contradiction notes.
Confirmed Hässleby-Silverån reserve rules, general fire/dog/currentness guidance, no HÖ3-specific closure found, water/fishing caveats and Silverån flood caution.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Strong enough for research-ready normalization with caveats. No second agent batch needed now because official metadata, GPX/API geometry, endpoint coordinates, core facilities, public-transport access and protected-area rules are well covered. Remaining weaknesses are mostly normalization checks: reserve-boundary intersection, exact Göreda bro operator/stop validation, Åsjön subfacility condition/currentness, endpoint service seasonality and external connection modeling.
